notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
We welcome you to the Puppet Play Horror Picture Show! 
Much awaits you in this new addition to your own movie studio!

This update does add and change quite a lot of things! Lets get started with the new features!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/67a0997e5a6a81e19742ba1d540f3b92c53aa13e.png



Scaling!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/cc9d4bed7fc2f61a9ae080072451c84f1e5526ea.gif
You can now change and animate the size of mostly anything! Simply open the context menu and select "Show Scale" to activate it! You can switch between free & normal scaling by pressing the trigger!
The humanoid mouth puppets as well as the beloved stuffed T-rex don't support scaling yet! These need a more complex rework to handle that! This will be added in an update soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/37e97a35ac1f228c569eaf1f2f2eb7e901fa4f01.png



Animate Fingers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/dfefc0d22a2557494d74f129000d3afdee63b3d0.gif
Most humanoid figures (around 80%) now support finger animations in mocap mode! Also supports index controllers! 



New mouths for low poly characters!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/d1ec5d5afb328c1faf50aeb97d5d4449f59a219b.gif
Not a big addition, but I love how they look so I had to include them here!



Tutorial!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/5f94a47124eb70f985d1aebe31c1790b9d514fa3.png
Finally a tutorial! 


 Additional Feature List

 New default control scheme thats closer to conventional VR controller layouts. Also switched the sides of record and gallery button. 
 Gallery Changes: Moved player back to give a better overview of the shelves. improved distance grab
 Lock Items in Context menu to prevent accidentally grabbing attached hats or hair
 Smooth hand movement! Can be adjusted in settings
 Improved depth of field controller with depth layer indicator. Its located in the lens of the camera.
 Greatly improved light quality! Higher resolution and better contours
 New inverse kinematic system. That the thing that moved the arm, when you move the hand position. Arm position looks much more realistic now! Same for legs.
 New sprite for Timeline
 Environment light now gets darker when its set to night
 Many new settings:
 Settings to change export framerate and size
 Settings to change camera on screen
 Setting to change hand smoothness
 All settings are now saved.




New Assets:


Backrooms Set
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/f7fb228954a2f53d6108d2c81b7f65c5588a1061.png


Horror Set
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/2bd3bb64780665bef25f60e3f03aa39c1432bacf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/dc1ed89cc38b262c4bcb4a30e9308f5e22d00f34.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/f7248432c7a1c275296f1c1e676bebd13d911db1.png


New Characters & Props
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/f2f95511fd2f2b429a417a01be642a1b8eff02a2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/5c4d599fc5cba8e170fe19a9205a054d3b9fdad7.png


Also:

 New food items
 new set of cardboard props
 Added more props to anime city set



Thats it!
Also in case you are in Hamburg, Germany next week: Puppet Play is being shown on the PLAY Creative Gaming Festival!. It was nominated for the "Most Creative Game" - Award!

Here are some more examples:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/ab4444aee67a58c65482a231b68784a8c88fed15.gif

notes.title: Beach Update!
notes.notes:
Inflation crossed your holiday planning? Don't worry, the paradise beach isn't far! Get your bathing suit and animate the vacation of a lifetime! Comes all-inclusive with some new features & assets!

Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/e633670e460341126fb3273c8cafeb34fbe8b068.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/4be60d1f37b6b5ca953eb47f35e989d9a30d5baf.gif
You can now change the intensity & spread of the light! 
Whenever you are making a movie that is not set in a studio with a sun as a light source, use the light to add some depth! Makes every scene 1000x nicer! :) 







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41059225/6ea9597f36692dcd55011cb0bc1a1d4162c4c989.gif

notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.notes:
Seems like you were on Santa's nice list this year! Lets see what presents he has for you:

Features:

 New Christmas Puppets
 New Christmas Props & Items
 New locomotion method using one stick to move and one to rotate. Press in left jostick to edit timeline


Bug Fixes:

 No microphones shown in debug menu
 removed endless loading bug when starting game
 fixes issue with vive controllers
 fixed mouth puppet remotes not disappearing properly
 some smaller fixes as well!



So this is the first and last update for Puppet Play for the rest of the year! We want to use this oppurtunity to thank everyone who has supported us so far! We had a great launch and can't wait to see what you'll think of all the things we have planned for the future!

Merry Christmas and a good slide into the New Year (as we say here in Germany) !
